customer_name: IBM CIO Security and Compliance Enablement
business_problem: IBM's CIO organization was running end-of-life, stovepipe GRC applications that could not support a broader transformation toward unified controls, assurance, risk and compliance workflows.
solution_summary: IBM's CIO Security and Compliance Enablement team rebuilt its governance, risk and compliance environment on IBM OpenPages with IBM Cognos Analytics for reporting. The initial scope covered Corporate Assurance and Advisory Services and Finance Business Controls, whose processes span audits, mergers and acquisitions reviews, SOX compliance and management certification. OpenPages was selected because it could model complex workflows, be customized without heavy developer involvement and align to a more business-centric operating model rather than a collection of custom applications. Cognos supplies the report-formatting and presentation layer for the formal outputs consumed by leadership and the audit committee. By consolidating assurance and controls work on a single adaptive GRC platform, the team gained a clearer business-unit view of risk posture, laid the groundwork for broader enterprise integration and created a more extensible base for future AI-first governance workflows.

solution_components.name: IBM OpenPages
solution_components.role: Runs the configurable workflows, controls and case-management processes at the center of IBM's GRC transformation.

solution_components.name: IBM Cognos Analytics
solution_components.role: Formats and delivers reports generated from the new GRC platform for leaders and audit stakeholders.

data_flow: Audit, business-controls and compliance data flows into OpenPages workflows, where it is managed on a common enterprise platform and then surfaced through Cognos Analytics reports and dashboards for leadership assessment.
business_outcome: IBM replaced legacy GRC silos with a more flexible platform that shortens delivery effort, supports hundreds of users globally and gives leadership a more holistic view of controls and risk.
architecture_clues: The MVP for CA&AS was delivered in less than a year with a small team.
The transformation strategy explicitly aims to integrate business controls, corporate assurance, risk, security and business continuity on one platform.
OpenPages was chosen in part for low-code workflow changes that reduce developer dependence.
evidence_quotes: completed the OpenPages MVP ... in less than a year with a small team
Over 700 users access the GRC platform
